sources.entry: Brave Browser - Brave browser for Desktop and Laptop computers running Windows, macOS, and Linux.

summary.one_liner: The brave/brave-browser repository is a companion repo for the Brave Browser desktop app that holds issues, releases, and the wiki, but not the source code.
summary.what_it_does: The README states that this repository does not contain the code needed to build the browser; the source and contributions live elsewhere (the link was stripped from the README). It serves as the hub for Brave Browser's bug reports and feature requests via GitHub Issues, and for releases hosted on GitHub, which follow the Brave Release Schedule. It points to a Wiki with developer, administrator, and power-user documentation, and to a separate help center for user-facing docs. It also links to contributing guidelines, a security policy, and community channels such as a Q&A forum and a Slack channel.
use_cases: Reading developer and admin documentation for Brave
Finding Brave's security policy and contribution guidelines
notable: Does not contain the browser source code; it is an issues, releases, and wiki repository
Releases are hosted on GitHub and follow the Brave Release Schedule
Wiki contains build instructions for developers
caveats: Source code is not in this repository, so it cannot be built from here
README is brief and some links were removed, so the source location is not stated
